data.gender_notes: Thala is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Thala means 'God' or 'King' in Tamil language. It is a unisex name that represents power, strength, and courage. In Hinduism, Thala is also a name for Lord Murugan, the god of war and victory. The name Thala carries the meaning “God, King, Leader” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Tamil. Parents who choose Thala usually hope their child will grow to embody god, king, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
